design_philosophy: Modern Growth Platform. The app is a warm, approachable command center for a small business owner, not a terminal for an engineer. We optimize for clarity, encouragement, and confident next actions — generous whitespace, soft elevation, and a friendly indigo/violet brand voice replace the earlier Swiss Brutalist direction (docs/DESIGN.md's 'Daylight Ledger' and the Phase A-D Klein Blue rebuild are both superseded; nothing in the app should still read as either).

typography.strategy: One clean sans-serif family carries both headings and body — no separate brutalist display face. Numbers are the one place typography gets deliberately technical: every number in the app (metrics, table values, scores, money) is monospace with tabular-nums, so columns of figures always align.

hierarchy.metrics: font-mono text-3xl sm:text-4xl font-semibold tracking-tight tabular-nums

typography.instructions: Every number — metric cards, table cells, scores, dollar amounts, percentages — uses font-mono with tabular-nums, and is right-aligned wherever it sits in a table column. Headings never use a separate 'display' face; weight and size carry the hierarchy, not a different font.

colors.archetype: Warm SaaS — indigo/violet primary, teal secondary accent, light by default
colors.theme_preference: Light theme by default: white cards floating on a soft light-gray page background. A dark mode exists and inverts cleanly, but light is the primary, designed-for surface.
rules: Primary (indigo) is the default interactive color: links, selected nav, form focus rings, most buttons.

The indigo-to-violet gradient is reserved for the single recurring 'Fix this for me' CTA and other AI-initiated actions — it should read as 'AI did or will do this', not be used decoratively elsewhere.
Teal is a secondary accent for a second data series, a distinct status, or to keep an all-indigo page from feeling monotone — never the primary action color.
Status colors (success/warning/destructive) are reserved for real state (a chip, a trend arrow, a severity badge) and never doubled as decoration.
Must have a Light/Dark theme toggle.

visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid, using the soft --border token (slate-200 in light, slate-800 in dark) — never a harsh black/white line.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Soft elevation, not hard brutalist shadows: shadow-sm on resting cards, shadow-md on hover or an elevated/floating surface (dropdowns, the AI panel). No hard-edge offset shadows.
visual_enhancers.radius: Rounded throughout — rounded-xl (12px) on cards and panels, rounded-lg (8px) on buttons/inputs/chips, rounded-full on pills and avatars. Nothing should render with a square (rounded-none) corner anymore.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Not used. Solid card backgrounds with a soft shadow are the elevation language here, not blur.
visual_enhancers.icons: Phosphor Icons (@phosphor-icons/react). 'duotone' or 'fill' weight for nav and hero moments, 'regular' for dense inline UI.

layouts.strategy: Generous, breathable grid. Space communicates confidence, not density for its own sake.
layouts.app_shell: Persistent left sidebar (all six lifecycle modules always visible, in order, plus Command Center and Settings) + main content area with generous padding (p-6 to p-8) and a max content width.
layouts.command_center: 8 metric cards in a responsive grid, then a two-column row: a prominent indigo Next Best Action panel beside a Revenue Trend chart and a Sales Pipeline funnel.
layouts.kanban_operate: Horizontal Kanban columns (New Lead / Contacted / Quoted / Won), cards with soft shadows and rounded corners, a right-hand summary sidebar (pipeline value, conversion rate, scheduling, invoices).
layouts.spacing: Generous card padding (p-6/p-8), gap-6 between grid items — nothing should feel packed edge-to-edge.
layouts.alignment: Left-align labels and text; right-align every numeric column in a table.

motion.interactions: Soft, deliberate hover states — a slight shadow lift or background tint, never a hard color inversion. Target specific properties, never `transition: all`.
motion.ai_streaming: Streaming AI text appears in a distinct indigo-tinted panel with a soft pulsing/glowing indicator while active, not a monospace terminal block.
motion.loaders: Soft pulsing skeletons matching the card's rounded shape — no ASCII art, no hard geometric loaders.

components.buttons: Rounded-lg, solid indigo fill for primary, soft shadow. 'Fix this for me' is the recurring primary CTA everywhere an AI action is available — same gradient treatment every time it appears.
components.cards: White, rounded-xl, 1px soft border, shadow-sm at rest, shadow-md on hover.
components.gauge: Large centred circular SEO Health Score gauge (SVG), indigo progress arc, big mono score in the centre.
components.inputs: Rounded-lg, 1px soft border, indigo focus ring.
components.tables: Comfortable row height, left-aligned text, right-aligned mono numbers, soft 1px row dividers (no harsh borders).
components.locked_modules: Never hidden — shown in the sidebar in lifecycle order with a padlock icon and a 'Soon' badge, and route to a real locked-module page (not a dead tooltip) describing what the module will do.

accessibility.contrast: Minimum 4.5:1 text, 3:1 for large UI elements.
accessibility.testing: Interactive and key informational elements should be identifiable (data-testid or an equivalent stable selector).
accessibility.focus: Focus rings use the primary indigo with an offset for clear visibility.

instructions_to_main_agent: Replace every remaining Swiss Brutalist token (radius 0, harsh 1px black borders, Klein Blue, JetBrains-Mono-for-everything) — no page should keep the old look.

Sidebar: all six modules always visible in lifecycle order (Command Center, Build, Source, Operate, ScaleSEO, Grow, AI Team, Settings). Unbuilt ones get a 'Soon' badge and a real locked-module page, never hidden or a dead end.
Command Center: 8 metric cards, then Next Best Action (indigo panel, 'Fix this for me' per action) beside Revenue Trend (real data, real empty state) and a Sales Pipeline funnel.
ScaleSEO: centred circular Health Score gauge with five flanking subscore bars, Priority Actions with severity chips and 'Fix this for me', Local Rankings, an AI recommendation card.
Operate: Kanban (New Lead/Contacted/Quoted/Won) plus a right summary sidebar.
AI Team: six assistant cards, each with a model dropdown defaulting to Auto, honest about which are actually active (real usage) versus not (show purpose, not fabricated numbers).
Sign-in: split layout, photo left with the positioning line overlaid, form right, indigo/violet — not orange.
Keep the API, RLS tenancy, and page structure — this is a styling and layout pass only.
